title: Sprint 4 - declared done-gates tier 1
description: SPRINT BRIEF. Close the accountability gap where closeout gates validate record shape but not truth: evidence outcome passed and the command string are self-asserted and never matched against anything declared at filing time (packages/evidence-engine/src/evidence.ts lines 44-73, gate evaluation at packages/engine/src/runtime.ts lines 1401-1483). Tier 1 is match-only, no execution: RequiredCloseoutGate gains optional declaredCommand and expectedObservable; a satisfying evidence record must carry command equal to declaredCommand and a summary or artifact matching expectedObservable. This forces the filer-declared gate to be echoed at close and makes invented closes detectably non-conforming. The declared gate also surfaces as a blocking directive at pickup via the sprint 3 machinery, so executors see the done condition when they claim, not at close-rejection. Tier 2 execute-at-close ships only as a policy-gated draft task, not ready, pending an owner decision. Done when a fixture work order filed with a declared gate cannot close on mismatched evidence and the gate is visible in the claim handoff.
acceptanceCriteria: All non-draft child tasks closed with passed verification evidence
Commit checkpoint SHA recorded for the sprint
closedReason: All Sprint 4 children are closed and rollup evidence recorded.
